GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, under pressure turn and dropped out # faced breeze
Jumped Well pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed apssing 200m , kept on welll just on match once headed # led/headed 200m
Jumped Ok , controlled race in front 1000m, challenged on the corner but she found another gear last 200m and proved too smart # led all the way
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, drew 1 length clear approaching 100m and kept going strong to the line # led/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr rep he had not intended to lead the race, however, after placing the mare under some pressure leaving the barriers, it responded well to his riding and mustered quickly, whereby he was able to obtain the lead without overly pressuring his mount.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back near last 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home ok # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well landed rail half off, improved turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed approaching 200m and faded # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the mare, which was racing in blinkers for the first time, raced too keenly throughout the early and middle stages and, as a consequence, weakened over the final 150m, and in her opinion it may also have come to the end of its preparation. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr agreed with rdr and advised the mare will be spelled.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Improved Outside Leader 1l. Under Good Hold Same and closer to Turn . Straightened Up wider to better ground, Battled On Well but No Match 1-2 to 200m and held ( ttie 1st time ) # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: Intention to be ridden further forward; settled outside the lead. Slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , then Took A Sit Two Wide 7th 6 Lengths @ 800m. Hooked Out Middle Of Track Straightening Up as they all did . Just couldn't quicken at all (vetted - no abnormalities) # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported he intended on settling in the lead and, despite beginning well, when pressuring his mnt in the early stages it failed to muster sufficient speed to lead and, as a consequence, settled midfield. He said his mnt did not appreciate racing in amongst horses and came under pressure rounding the home turn, and it raced greenly in the early part of the straight, but finished off its race satisfactorily. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out at 1000m and worked up to sit Two Wide Outside Lead at the 850m, held together much same to turn Two Wide trailing a half length, shifted 5-6 Wide Straightening Up , hit Lead 200m, kept steering wider down the running. First start: Like to see again. # battled on well
